summary: A fabulous three bedroomed family home located to the south of the City of Carlisle, the property has great access to local transport links, M6 and local amenities.
description:
Entrance hall leading to a large open plan lounge/ diner with dual aspect bay window and patio doors leading out to rear garden. Also leading from the hallway is a modest kitchen with modern wall and base units and integrated appliances including electric hob, oven and extractor fan. The kitchen benefits from under stair storage area, and allows access to a large garage with electricity. To the first floor are two double bedrooms,the master bedroom has a bay style window, one single bedroom and a three piece family bathroom. Each room is neutrally decorated and tastefully carpeted. To the front of the property is a lawned garden with driveway parking for at least two cars and access to the garage. To the rear of the property is a lawned and paved rear garden, which provides an excellent private outside space. Viewing advised to appreciate accommodation on offer.

Services Mains Electricity, Gas and Water.
